mechanism.claim: When completed eight-hour BTC spot and perpetual signed aggressive-quote-flow shares have the same strict sign, spot flow is more extreme by an unusually large amount, perpetual realized variation is elevated, and perpetual open interest expands, cash-led informed execution with fresh leveraged sponsorship should propagate in the common flow direction for eight hours.
mechanism.side: strict common sign of completed eight-hour BTC spot and perpetual signed aggressive-quote-flow shares
mechanism.why_distinct: HVCFOIR compares signed aggressive quote flow in actual BTC spot and perpetual markets, requires positive spot-flow leadership and exact perpetual OI expansion, and follows the common flow direction. HVSFL used spot-only late flow without OI; HVCSPIR used completed returns and failed train. HVCFOIR reuses neither event set nor control and uses no return direction, ETH, funding, premium-index, fitted outcome, or promoted control.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: the completed intervening eight-hour BTC realized variation must be in its causal upper 40 percent
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: fixed eight-hour cash-flow-led OI-sponsored spot-perpetual states are absent from Gross9 primitives

features.open_interest: finite positive BTCUSDT period=5m sum_open_interest observations at D-8h and D, each exchange-timestamped no later than D
features.completed_cycles: 480 exact coherent one-minute rows with nonnegative quote_asset_volume and 0<=taker_buy_quote<=quote_asset_volume from bars_binance_spot and bars_binance BTCUSDT over [D-8h,D)
features.signed_flow_shares: sum(2*taker_buy_quote-quote_asset_volume)/sum(quote_asset_volume) for spot and perpetual; denominators positive, both shares strict nonzero and same strict sign
features.spot_flow_lead_rank: strict-prior midrank over at most 270 source-valid cycles; current excluded; minimum 180; rank>=0.60
features.realized_variation: sqrt(sum squared one-minute log(close/open) returns over exactly 480 coherent BTCUSDT bars [D-8h,D))
features.variation_rank: strict-prior midrank over at most 270 source-valid cycles; current excluded; minimum 180; rank>=0.60
features.eligible: exact coherent completed spot and perpetual cycles with same-sign flow shares and positive spot-flow lead, two exact perpetual OI endpoints with strict expansion, and both spot-flow-lead and variation ranks pass at D; no return direction, funding, range, midpoint, premium-index, alt, or post-decision condition

clock.reservation: global half-open; exit first on equal entry
clock.funding: not a signal input; exact held settlements only after source and Gross9 pass

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

source_plan.open_interest: Postgres open_interest_binance BTCUSDT period=5m exact endpoint observations
source_plan.bars: Postgres bars_binance_spot and bars_binance BTCUSDT exact coherent 1m OHLC plus quote_asset_volume and taker_buy_quote
source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source support and Gross9 pass

research_boundary.classification: exploratory discovery; not fresh confirmatory evidence

stopping_rule: terminal first failure; no OI endpoint or expansion rule, spot/perpetual source, signed-flow formula or agreement, spot-flow lead, variation history, side, clock, hold, subset, threshold, comparator, or control repair
